tips.title: Trade fillers for silence
tips.tip: When you feel an 'um' or 'uh' coming, pause silently instead — a brief quiet beat sounds far more confident than a filler and gives you time to find the word.

tips.title: Chunk your sentences
tips.tip: Long mid-sentence pauses usually mean you're planning too far ahead; speak in shorter phrases and pause at natural boundaries (after commas) rather than in the middle of an idea.

tips.title: Finish the sentence you started
tips.tip: When you catch yourself restarting, try to complete the original sentence even if it's imperfect — it's better to finish a slightly clumsy sentence than to abandon several half-formed ones.

tips.title: Aim for a steady, even pace
tips.tip: Pick a comfortable speed and keep it consistent; slowing down slightly on key words and adding tiny pauses for emphasis reads as clarity, not hesitation.
